checks.red_team: The 164 figure is the Air Force's 08:00 summary counting from 18:00 on 7 Nov, decoys included and missiles separate, so it matches the claim's rule; no counting change, pause or attack under way found. Suggested trimming to about 0.64 because the five share one base rate; the calibrated figure is kept as the rule requires.
